subject: Security & Compliance: Architecture review (SOC 2 evidence, SSO, encryption, audit logs)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acmecorp.com>
Cc: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security & Compliance: Architecture review (SOC 2 evidence, SSO, encryption, audit logs)

Hi Alice,

Thanks again for taking time to review Redwood with the Acme security team. As discussed on the call, we'd like to schedule a technical deep-dive to walk through our architecture with an emphasis on SOC 2 evidence items: encryption at rest/in transit, audit logging and retention, SSO/SAML/OIDC integration, and key management.

Suggested length: 60–90 minutes (deep-dive + Q&A). Proposed times (PT):
- Tue Mar 24, 10:00–11:30
- Wed Mar 25, 11:00–12:30
- Thu Mar 26, 09:00–10:30

Agenda (high level):
- 10 min intros & scope
- 30–45 min architecture & controls: encryption, KMS, network isolation
- 15–20 min audit logs & retention (sample exports)
- 15 min SSO / provisioning flow (Okta)
- 10–15 min open Q&A and next steps

I've attached our SOC2 evidence checklist and a current architecture diagram to give your team context before the meeting. If you can confirm a time and the list of internal attendees (including any Okta/PAM contacts), we'll send a calendar invite and share the detailed agenda.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-checklist.pdf, redwood-architecture-diagram.vsdx

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — Wednesday Mar 25 11:00–12:30 PT works best for our team. Can you please include anyone responsible for our Okta integration? Also, could you share an attendee-level list of evidence you plan to cover (types of logs, retention windows, encryption key ownership) so our auditors can triage?

Attendees from Acme: Alice Johnson (security lead), Ben Park (compliance), security@acmecorp.com (team inbox).

Thanks,
Alice

Thanks, Alice — Wed Mar 25 11:00–12:30 PT is penciled in.

Laura — looping you in for the SSO/Okta portion and to cover provisioning and SCIM flows.
Dev & Rishi — can you prepare a short set of artifacts we can share ahead of the meeting:
- Sample audit-log export (redacted) showing event schemas and retention windows
- KMS key ownership diagram & encryption-at-rest details
- Any SOC 2 artifact locations (S3 buckets, retention policies) we can point Acme auditors to

I've attached a proposed agenda doc; we'll finalize before sending the invite. If anything is missing from Acme's ask, flag it here.

Marissa

One logistical note: I'm on-call the morning of Wed Mar 25 and there's a pager rotation overlap that looks unavoidable. Would the Acme team accept moving the start to 12:00–13:30 PT instead? That'd give me time to hand off and be fully present. If not, I can arrange coverage but prefer the shift.
